title: Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap. A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law). Margins are small in five corpora and two embedding models, so an idealised tolerance at the level of floating-point noise leaves up to 5.5% of queries exposed (at most 1.2% in any corpus once exact duplicate documents are excluded), and a threshold calibrated from our CPU INT8-FP32 comparison of a small embedding model (at the empirical 0.1% quantile of honest cosines) leaves 98-100% exposed; on a Raspberry

translated_title: 已签名却仍可被操纵：测量并弥合离线检索增强生成中的文本-向量完整性鸿沟
translated_abstract: 在边缘设备上运行的离线检索增强生成（RAG）通过携带文本和预计算嵌入向量的签名知识包进行更新。签名只能证明知识包由谁发布，却不能证明其中的向量确实编码了对应的文本。我们研究了这种“文本-向量完整性鸿沟”。一个会重新计算向量并在余弦容差范围内接受它们的验证器，会将可预测比例的查询拱手让给控制向量的攻击者：劫持率等于该容差处角度检索边际的分布（即“边际定律”）。在五个语料库和两个嵌入模型上，检索边际都很小，因此处于浮点噪声级别的理想化容差会使最多5.5%的查询暴露于攻击之下（排除完全重复文档后，任何语料库中最多为1.2%），而根据我们对小型嵌入模型的CPU INT8-FP32对比校准的阈值（取诚实余弦的经验0.1%分位数处）则会使98-100%的查询暴露于攻击之下；在树莓派上……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了离线RAG签名知识包中“签名只证明发布者身份、无法保证向量与文本一致”这一安全鸿沟，提出了量化攻击者可劫持查询比例的“边际定律”，并给出了测量与弥合该完整性差距的验证方案。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the text-vector integrity gap in signed offline RAG knowledge packs—where signatures attest to the publisher but not to whether vectors encode their text—proves a "margin law" quantifying the predictable fraction of hijackable queries, and proposes methods to measure and close this gap.
